title: Panel Component
summary: Official Derivative overview of Panel Components, the Component sub-family used to create custom interactive 2D control panels and user interfaces in TouchDesigner.
guidance: Use this article when selecting a 2D UI component family for panels, controls, widgets, parameter surfaces, operator viewers, or optimized table-like UI.
Choose Container COMP as the usual parent when placing panels inside panels; attached nodes in the same network can also participate in panel parenting like 3D Parenting.
Use OP Viewer COMP when an operator viewer should become a panel, and Parameter COMP when an operator's parameters should become a panel surface.
For scripted behavior, connect this page with Panel Value, Panel Execute DAT, PanelValue Class, PanelCOMP Class, and the individual Panel COMP classes.
